SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'DHJB') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO AS KEP_RE_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ AS KEP_RE_SEQ, A.REVISION AS REVISION, A.KEY_10 AS COMPANY, SUBSTR(A.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE,1,2) AS PLANT, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.MAKER_NAME, A.DELIVERY_LT, A.UNIT_PRICE, A.REMARK, A.ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT MAX(USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME, A.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE, A.KEY_1 AS CATEGORY1, A.KEY_2 AS CATEGORY2, A.KEY_3 AS CATEGORY3 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
